permit.applies: The engaging organisation in Malawi applies on the applicant's behalf at the Immigration Headquarters or a Regional Immigration Office, paying the processing fee; the TEP Approval Committee considers it and the Minister decides, while the applicant waits outside Malawi.
permit.first: The post advertised locally with no suitably qualified Malawian found, and a qualified Malawian named to understudy the expatriate.

fees.what: Temporary employment permit, all other TEP (2021 schedule)

sources.title: Department of Immigration and Citizenship Services (Malawi), Temporary Employee Permit
sources.said: This permit is issued to persons before they enter Malawi for the purpose of taking up specified employment in Malawi. … The organisation has the responsibility to apply for the permit on behalf of the applicant . … The TEP application form and supporting documents are submitted at the Immigration Headquarters or Regional Immigration Offices for processing upon payment of the processing fees . … The application will be submitted to the TEP Approval Committee for consideration, then the Minister for decision. … If approved one will be required to pay the appropriate fees within 30 days from date of notification. … A TEP can be renewed twice through submission of a TEP Renewal Application Form … All applicants for new TEP are required by law to wait outside Malawi until the application has been approved.

sources.title: Department of Immigration and Citizenship Services (Malawi), Notice on Temporary Employment Permits
sources.said: It is a requirement that vacancies in Malawi should first be offered to qualified Malawians. Only in cases where there is demonstrated shortage of skills within Malawi can the position be offered to an expatriate. All applications should show that the post was advertised locally and that it was not possible to identify a suitably qualified person locally TEP applications should include details of a qualified Malawian who will understudy the expatriate and will eventually take over the post. … a TEP except one for a key post may only be renewed twice and it is not automatic. … A Temporary Employment Permit authorizes such person, together with his wife and children under the age of eighteen years and dependent relatives, and subject to such conditions as may be prescribed, to reside within that area for the purpose of engaging in that occupation for a period of not less than six months or more than two years. A Temporary Employment Permit may be renewed after two years if the holder of the permit is still engaged in the employment for which the permit was issued at the date of expiry of such Permit.
